title: Transilience report_data
description: Input to generate_report.py. Only `engagement` and `findings` are required; every other key is an optional section that is skipped when absent.

duration.description: assessment window / effort, e.g. '23 Jun – 04 Jul 2026 (8 working days)' — renders as the cover DURATION row

cover_meta.description: Optional explicit [[label,value],...] override for the cover metadata table

metrics.description: Up to 6 KPI boxes. If omitted, auto-derived from severity counts.

sections.description: Free-form sections (e.g. Scope, Methodology) rendered after the exec summary.

internal.description: If true, the section is retained in report_data.json (internal record / QA log, e.g. blind-validation reproduction) but is NEVER rendered into the client PDF.

ease_of_exploitation.description: exploitability rating/rationale, e.g. 'Easy — no auth, remotely reachable'

references.description: advisory/standard URLs rendered under a REFERENCES block

poc.description: Ordered proof-of-concept steps (merges the former evidence / poc_request / screenshot fields). Each step renders as a numbered prose description, an optional code-styled command (the exact command to run at that step), and an optional embedded image.

description.description: what this step does / what you observe (prose)

command.description: the exact command/URL to run at this step; rendered as a monospace code block

image_url.description: local path or http(s) URL to a screenshot/output image; embedded inline when available

attack_pattern_coverage.description: Deterministic (surface-unit × attack-class) coverage matrix, derived from tools/coverage_gate.py's reports/coverage-matrix.json. Status column values covered|covered_negative|deferred|pending are colour-coded (deferred = blocked on client input, amber).

source_ips.description: rows of [source IP, role, provider/region] — every IP attacks/recon originated from

conclusion.description: closing section: overall security opinion + engagement limitations

assessment.description: overall assessment paragraph(s) — string or string[]

limitations.description: project limitations — string or string[] (rendered as bullets)
